From: Rachel Green <rachel.green@novus-healthcare.com>

Cc: Novus Security Team <security@novus-healthcare.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: subprocessor roster + supporting evidence for SIG/CAIQ review

Sergio —

Thanks for taking the call this morning. Novus is kicking off a rapid SIG/CAIQ review for our Q1 vendor assessment. We need the following from Redwood so our external assessor can complete the scope by 1/20:

- Full list of subprocessors (current as of today) with location and purpose.
- Dataflow diagram that shows where Novus customer data (PII/PHI) may transit or be stored.
- Latest attestation / SOC2 summary and any SIG/CAIQ evidence you can share (controls map preferred).

If possible, please bundle items into a single drive link and include any redactions for internal-only IDs. Also let us know the contact for a quick follow-up call with AuditsPlus (they may have a couple clarifying questions).

Appreciate it — deadline is tight.

Cheers,
Rachel Green
Vendor Risk Manager
Novus Healthcare

Attachment: request-checklist.txt (1 KB stub)
